notes.title: Critical bug Fixed + Credits update + Polish lines
notes.notes:
Our game was unavailable for about 12 hours. 
We offer our deepest apologies, this was due to a recent update.
Many thanks to player Jossy for bringing this problem to our attention.

Changelist:

 Fixed a critical bug that prevented the game from starting.
 Credits list was updated (new entry: Jossy)
 A few lines of Polish was updated (thanks, Klamos)
